turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I just moved into an apartment and the oven is disgusting. Where do I even start?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Take the racks out and soak them in the bathtub with hot water and dish soap. Then coat the inside with a baking soda paste and leave it overnight.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can cook tonight and start the paste after. Cleaning a slightly warm oven is actually a bit easier.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What do I do in the morning?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Wipe off the paste with a damp cloth, then spray a little vinegar on the leftover bits. It fizzes and loosens them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the glass on the door?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Same paste, then a razor scraper held flat for the tough spots. Go gently so you don't scratch it.
